source: spl-record 0.3.0 (solana-program-library record program, crates.io spl-record-0.3.0, Apache-2.0): bench/real/o_record
about: Open-source program, unmodified logic: the clean build is expected to have no finding; each variant removes exactly one validation and expects one of its rules at its instruction. Scored for rules only. Instructions by RecordInstruction tag; accounts in index order.

why.record: Written (authority, version): the runtime only lets the owning program write, so it is a record-program account; version != 1 required (AccountAlreadyInitialized), so an initialized record cannot be re-initialized.
why.authority: Only its key is recorded, no signature by design (as spl-token InitializeAccount): the record account is created and initialized in one transaction by its payer.

why.record: Initialized (version) and written: record-program owned (runtime); the write range is bounded by the account length.

why.new_authority: Any key, chosen by the current authority.

why.record: Initialized; its lamports are debited to 0, which the runtime only allows the owning program to do.
why.destination: Any account, chosen by the authority (checked_add of the lamports). The data is not zeroed: a zero-lamport account is purged at the end of the transaction, and refunding it within the same transaction only revives the closer's own record with the same authority: no privilege gained.

why.record: Initialized; realloc is only allowed on an account the program owns (runtime).

write_no_signer.removed: write: check_authority's is_signer check (key equality kept; the other instructions keep the full check)
write_no_signer.impact: Anyone overwrites any record's data by passing the authority's public key unsigned. Nothing else in Write involves a signature (no CPI).

verified.program: +1 log "Incorrect record authority provided", +1 memcmp, -1 call of a function returning MissingRequiredSignature
verified.code: -1 Err(ProgramError::NotEnoughAccountKeys), -1 Err(ProgramError::MissingRequiredSignature), -1 log "Record authority signature missing", -1 call of a function returning MissingRequiredSignature
verified.analysis: found in the clean build only: account[1].key, field_eq account[0].data ~ account[1].key

set_authority_no_signer.removed: set_authority: check_authority's is_signer check (key equality kept)
set_authority_no_signer.impact: Anyone sets itself as the authority of any record (passing the current authority's key unsigned), then writes, reallocates or closes it and takes its lamports.

verified.program: +1 log "Incorrect record authority provided", +1 memcmp, -1 call of a function returning MissingRequiredSignature
verified.code: -1 Err(ProgramError::NotEnoughAccountKeys), -1 Err(ProgramError::MissingRequiredSignature), -1 log "Record authority signature missing", -1 call of a function returning MissingRequiredSignature, +1 Err(ProgramError::InvalidAccountData), +1 Err(ProgramError::UninitializedAccount), +1 log "Record account not initialized"
verified.analysis: found in the clean build only: account[1].key, field_eq account[0].data ~ account[1].key

close_no_key.removed: close_account: check_authority's key == record.authority (signer check kept)
close_no_key.impact: Any signer closes any record and sends its lamports to a destination of its choice: theft of the rent and destruction of the data. The signer is not related to the record by anything else.

verified.analysis: found in the clean build only: account[1].key, field_eq account[0].data ~ account[1].key; in the variant only: account[1].signer

discarded.reason: none in the source to remove: every instruction writes the record's data or debits its lamports, which the runtime only allows for accounts owned by the record program.
low impact: realloc can only grow the record within the lamports it already holds (the runtime rejects leaving a rent-exempt account non-exempt) and writes no data; griefing at most.
not one of the account-validation kinds of this set (re-initialization); the a_audit / generated sets cover reinit-unchecked.
